package.description: Validate IPTV playlists and inspect stream health.

en-US.description: Validate IPTV playlists and inspect stream health.
en-US.longDescription: Cross-platform desktop application for validating IPTV playlists. Load M3U/M3U8 files, URLs, Xtream Codes, or Stalker portals. Scans channels for health status, captures thumbnails, detects codecs and resolution via ffmpeg, and exports results as CSV, M3U, or JSON.
en-US.name: IPTV Checker
